```odin
import fx "fire:fx"
```

Effects and filters, as units to run on stereo buffers (and nodes to put
in a graph): the eight filter models a synth voice has (`filter_render`),
and the effects a synth chains after its voices: chorus, a three-band
compressor, delay, distortion, EQ, a filter, flanger, phaser and reverb.
Each takes its settings as a plain struct and glides between renders,
so they can be modulated, and allocates nothing while it runs (the delay
lines are in its state, made with the effect).

```odin
state: fx.Distortion
p := fx.DISTORTION_DEFAULTS
p.drive_db = 12
fx.distortion_render(&state, &p, left, right, sample_rate)
```

Tempo divisions effects sync to (an index), as cycles a beat: 0 is

## Types

### Line

```odin
Line :: struct {
	buf: []f32,
	mask: int,
	at: int,
}
```

A delay line a side (or a voice): written a sample at a time, read
`past` samples back (2 or more), cubically between samples. Its length
is a power of two. Made with `line_make`.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `buf` |  |
| `mask` |  |
| `at` | where the next sample goes |

### Sync

```odin
Sync :: enum u8 {
	Free,
	Tempo,
	Dotted,
	Triplet,
}
```

How a rate is set: free (in Hz), or to the tempo (straight, dotted or
triplet).

### Distortion_Type

```odin
Distortion_Type :: enum u8 {
	Soft_Clip,
	Hard_Clip,
	Linear_Fold,
	Sine_Fold,
	Bit_Crush,
	Down_Sample,
}
```

What a distortion does to the signal.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Soft_Clip` | tanh |
| `Hard_Clip` | clipped at ±1 |
| `Linear_Fold` | folded back in straight lines |
| `Sine_Fold` | folded through a sine |
| `Bit_Crush` | steps |
| `Down_Sample` | held for longer, the lower the drive |

```odin
Filter_Order :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Pre,
	Post,
}
```

Where a distortion's filter is.

### Filter_Model

```odin
Filter_Model :: enum u8 {
	Analog,
	Dirty,
	Ladder,
	Digital,
	Diode,
	Formant,
	Comb,
	Phaser,
}
```

A synth voice's filter: one of eight models, each with styles, a
cutoff (as a key, so modulation moves it in semitones), resonance,
drive and a blend between its responses.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Analog` | a Sallen-Key: two resonant poles (12 dB) or four (24 dB), driven into tanh |
| `Dirty` | the analog's poles saturating inside the loop |
| `Ladder` | four saturating poles with global feedback |
| `Digital` | a clean state-variable filter |
| `Diode` | a diode ladder: high-pass before, a nastier resonance |
| `Formant` | four band-passes on a vowel's formants, moved by X and Y |
| `Comb` | a tuned delay: combs and flangers |
| `Phaser` | all-pass stages with resonance: peaks or notches |

### Filter_Style

```odin
Filter_Style :: enum u8 {
	Db12,
	Db24,
	Notch_Pass_Swap,
	Dual_Notch_Band,
	Band_Peak_Notch,
	Shelving,
}
```

A style: how the model is wired. Not every model has every style; each
says which it takes (see `filter_styles`).

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Db12` | 12 dB: low, band and high by the blend |
| `Db24` | 24 dB |
| `Notch_Pass_Swap` | low-pass to notch to high-pass |
| `Dual_Notch_Band` | two notches, the blend moving them |
| `Band_Peak_Notch` | band-pass to peak to notch |
| `Shelving` | low shelf, peak, high shelf (Digital) |

### Filter_Params

```odin
Filter_Params :: struct {
	model: Filter_Model,
	style: Filter_Style,
	cutoff: f32,
	resonance: f32,
	drive_db: f32,
	blend: f32,
	mix: f32,
	gain_db: f32,
	formant_x: f32,
	formant_y: f32,
	formant_transpose: f32,
	formant_resonance: f32,
	formant_spread: f32,
	comb_offset: f32,
	mono: bool,
	clean: bool,
}
```

What a filter does for one render (modulated, in its working units).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `model` |  |
| `style` |  |
| `cutoff` | as a key (8..136; 60 is middle C) |
| `resonance` | 0..1 |
| `drive_db` | 0..20 |
| `blend` | 0..2: low (0), band (1), high (2) for most styles |
| `mix` | 0..1: the dry signal against the filtered |
| `gain_db` | shelving: the shelf's gain |
| `formant_x` |  |
| `formant_y` | 0..1: the vowel (Formant) |
| `formant_transpose` | semitones |
| `formant_resonance` | 0.3..1 |
| `formant_spread` | -1..1 |
| `comb_offset` | semitones the second comb sits above (0..84) |
| `mono` | the first side only (the second left as it is) |
| `clean` | Phaser: resonance through tanh, the input not clipped |

## Procedures

### line_make

```odin
line_make :: proc(frames: int, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> (l: Line, err: core.Error)
```

Control thread. A delay line holding at least `frames` samples.

### line_destroy

```odin
line_destroy :: proc(l: ^Line, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator)
```

Control thread. Frees a delay line.

### line_max

```odin
line_max :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line) -> f32
```

The longest delay a line can be read at (samples).

### line_clear

```odin
line_clear :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Clears a line.

### line_push

```odin
line_push :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line, x: f32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Writes the next sample.

### line_read

```odin
line_read :: proc "contextless"(l: ^Line, past: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The sample `past` samples back from the last written (2 ..
line_max), with a Catmull-Rom cubic between samples.

### equal_power

```odin
equal_power :: proc "contextless"(t: f32) -> (wet: f32, dry: f32)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Equal-power fade: the wet gain at `t` (0..1) and the dry gain.

### clip_large

```odin
clip_large :: proc "contextless"(x: f32) -> f32
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). A soft-knee clip of large values (straight to ±8 × 0.66, then
tanh): what a feedback loop is held by.

### sync_hz

```odin
sync_hz :: proc "contextless"(sync: Sync, hz: f32, tempo: int, bpm: f64) -> f32
```

### reverb_make

```odin
reverb_make :: proc(rv: ^Reverb, max_rate: f64, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> core.Error
```

Control thread. A reverb for sample rates up to `max_rate`.

### reverb_destroy

```odin

```

Control thread. Frees a reverb's lines.

### reverb_render

```odin
reverb_render :: proc "contextless"(rv: ^Reverb, p: ^Reverb_Params, l: []f32, r: []f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Runs the reverb over `l` and `r` in place: the input band-passed,
diffused through an all-pass per line, into sixteen delays that feed
each other (an orthogonal mix: a quarter of all, less half the line's
row and column of the 4 × 4), shelved and decayed so the tail falls 60 dB in
the decay time; their lengths scaled by the size and wandering with
the chorus; out through a pre-delay, the lines alternating sides.

### filter_render

```odin
filter_render :: proc "contextless"(f: ^Filter_State, p: ^Filter_Params, cutoff: []f32, in_: ^[2][]f32, out: ^[2][]f32, sample_rate: f64)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Filters `in_` (a channel each) into `out` with `p`, per sample at
the cutoffs in `cutoff` (keys, one a sample: modulation is in them).
`out` may be `in_`. Settings glide from the last render's across this
one.
